say:1:1530148401:1.text: When I make soup, I don't just use meat. I throw in bones and mushrooms too!
say:1:1530148401:1.source_cn: 我熬汤，除了放肉，还会加肉骨头和蘑菇！
say:1:1530148401:1.male: When I make soup, I don't just use meat. I throw in bones and mushrooms too!
say:1:1530148401:1.female: When I make soup, I don't just use meat. I throw in bones and mushrooms too!

say:2:1530148402:1.text: Here, take a whiff. Doesn't it smell better than plain old meat?
say:2:1530148402:1.source_cn: 你闻这味道，是不是比只放肉，更香？
say:2:1530148402:1.male: Here, take a whiff. Doesn't it smell better than plain old meat?
say:2:1530148402:1.female: Here, take a whiff. Doesn't it smell better than plain old meat?
